purpose: Generate polished, professional esports logos from a simple sentence containing a team name, colors, and optional theme cues. The AI should automatically choose the most relevant style profile while enforcing clean vector geometry, consistent wordmark construction, balanced symmetry, and studio-quality logo polish.

inputMode.expectedUserInput: A short sentence or prompt containing the team name, preferred colors, and optional theme direction.
exampleInputs: Team name: Rogue Rebels. Colors: black, red, white, and gray.
Create an esports logo for Dungeon Lords using purple, black, silver, and flame orange.
Team name: Pixel Runners. Colors: gold, purple, and black.
Team name: Bravo Unit X. Colors: olive, black, silver, and dark gray.

requiredFields.teamName: Required. Use the exact team name provided by the user.
requiredFields.colors: Required when provided. Use the exact colors requested by the user as the primary palette.

optionalFields.theme: Optional. If provided, use it to influence mascot, symbol, background energy, and style profile selection.
optionalFields.mascot: Optional. If provided, prioritize it over automatically inferred mascot ideas.
optionalFields.renderingPreference: Optional. Examples: flat vector, glow, pixel, tactical, fantasy, minimal, mascot-only, badge-only.

globalOutputRequirements.background: Dark, transparent, or team-color-based depending on usage
avoid: Overly rounded letters when the rest of the wordmark is angular
Excessive glow that changes the flat logo style

globalRenderingDefaults.description: Default to bold flat vector fills with hard-edged cel shading, clean shadows, and controlled highlight shapes. The logo should feel like a polished esports vector illustration, not a glossy 3D render.

avoid: Glow replacing the core flat fills
Overly cyberpunk color wash unless explicitly requested

allowedUse: Very subtle shade variation inside large flat areas
avoid: Uncontrolled color fading across entire letters

teamNameHandling.lineBreakGuidance: For two-word names, place the first word above the second word unless the design works better as a single compact line.

letterformConsistency.description: All letters in the same wordmark must share the same design logic, including angles, cut corners, terminal shapes, stroke width, bevel style, and outline thickness.
letterformConsistency.criticalRule: If one letter has a sharp pointed foot, notch, spike, bevel, or angled terminal, other compatible letters should echo that geometry. Do not mix a sharp angular R with a soft rounded S unless the user explicitly asks for mixed typography.

S.problemToAvoid: A rounded bottom-right S terminal that does not match the pointed angular feet of letters like R, E, L, or A.
S.preferredTreatment: Use an angular esports S with a pointed or beveled bottom-right terminal when surrounding letters use sharp pointed geometry.
S.terminalShape: pointed, chamfered, or beveled, not soft-rounded
S.baselineBehavior: The bottom of the S should visually align with the baseline geometry of neighboring letters.

R.preferredTreatment: Strong diagonal leg with a sharp or beveled foot.

E.preferredTreatment: Squared or angled horizontal bars with consistent cut angles.
E.avoid: Randomly rounded arms unless all typography is intentionally rounded.

G.preferredTreatment: Angular inner notch and consistent outer curve-to-corner logic.
G.avoid: Overly soft circular G if the rest of the wordmark is blocky.

outlineRules.description: Text outlines must be consistent and symmetrical.
outlineRules.shadowOffset: Same direction and thickness across all letters
avoid: one letter having a different outline thickness
rounded outline corners beside pointed letter corners

symmetryEnforcement.description: Ensure visual elements are mirror-balanced when the logo uses a centered badge, mascot, crest, or shield.
rules: Left and right visual weight should feel balanced.
If a border point appears on one side, the opposite side should have an equivalent point unless the design is intentionally asymmetric.
Mascot faces may be expressive, but eye size, brow angle, and head placement must feel professionally controlled.
Badge borders should not randomly bulge, flatten, or round on only one side.

anchorRefinement.description: Vector-like shapes should have clean anchor logic, controlled transitions, and intentional corners.
rules: No jagged accidental edges.
No floating points.
No awkward bumps in curves.
No uneven corners on mirrored forms.
Angular corners should use consistent bevel angles.

strokeConsistency.description: Outer borders, inner outlines, shadows, and highlights should use a clear visual hierarchy.
rules: Primary outer stroke should be the thickest.
Secondary inner strokes should be thinner but consistent.
Highlight strokes should not overpower the mascot or wordmark.
Typography stroke thickness should remain consistent across all letters.

spacingAlignment.description: Spacing should feel calculated, not accidental.
rules: Maintain even kerning across the wordmark.
Keep consistent padding between text and badge border.
Avoid cramped letters.
Avoid text touching mascot elements unless intentionally overlapped.
Center the wordmark under the mascot or icon.

compositionBalance.description: The full logo should work as a single identity mark.
rules: Mascot, wordmark, and badge must feel integrated.
Top and bottom sections should have balanced mass.
The icon should not overpower the team name.
The team name should remain readable at small sizes.
The silhouette should be recognizable even without inner detail.

styleSelectionLogic.selectionMethod: Choose the style profile whose keywords, subject matter, and color behavior best match the user's team name, colors, and optional theme.
priorityOrder: Explicit user theme or rendering preference
Genre cues such as cyber, fantasy, tactical, retro, horror, anime, minimal, or military

styleMatchingExamples.input: Rogue Rebels, black red white gray
styleMatchingExamples.reason: Aggressive team name, strong esports palette, mascot-friendly identity.
Fantasy naming, dark palette, mystical visual direction.
Pixel keyword strongly indicates arcade or retro treatment.

styleMatchingExamples.input: Bravo Unit X, olive black silver
styleMatchingExamples.reason: Military naming and tactical color palette.

modern-esports.name: Modern Esports Logo Style
modern-esports.description: A bold, aggressive, professional esports logo style built around mascots, sharp wordmarks, badge shapes, and high-contrast team colors. This style should look like a polished competitive gaming identity, using flat vector fills, hard-edged shading, and controlled accent lighting.

colorScheme.styleNote: Use the user-provided colors as the main palette. For black, red, white, and gray, keep the design flatter and more classic, using red as the main accent, white for text or highlights, gray for secondary shading, and black for the base mass.

visualCharacteristics.lineQuality: Clean bold vector lines with sharp corners, smooth intentional curves, and no messy raster texture.
visualCharacteristics.edgeStyle: Angular with controlled curves only where needed for hair, masks, animals, or clothing.
visualCharacteristics.fillType: Flat solid fills with hard cel-shaded shadow shapes.
visualCharacteristics.contrast: Very high contrast with strong silhouette clarity.
visualCharacteristics.stroke: Thick outer stroke with consistent inner stroke hierarchy.

renderingStyle.description: Use flat esports vector illustration with hard-edged shadows and highlights. Avoid excessive glow, heavy gradients, or glossy 3D rendering unless explicitly requested.
renderingStyle.notes: The logo should feel like the original flat-color esports style, not a glowing poster or semi-3D illustration.

subjectMatter.type: Mascot, masked figure, animal, emblem, tech symbol, custom wordmark

wordmarkTreatment.preferredLineBreak: Two-word names should usually be stacked, with the first word larger or equal to the second depending on composition.
wordmarkTreatment.specificInstruction: For names like Rogue Rebels, the S in Rebels must have an angular pointed or beveled bottom-right terminal that visually matches the pointed bottom geometry of the R and other block letters.

symmetryEnforcement.description: Ensure left and right visual elements are mirror-balanced when applicable.
symmetryEnforcement.notes: If one side has a pointed edge, mirror it precisely or balance it with an equivalent angular detail on the opposite side.

anchorRefinement.description: Control anchor handles to create precise curves and angle junctions.
anchorRefinement.notes: Avoid uneven curvature, floating anchor points, abrupt inflection angles, or accidental bumps.

strokeConsistency.description: Use uniform stroke widths or a deliberate stroke hierarchy for layered depth.
strokeConsistency.notes: Visually harmonize all stroke widths unless layering for depth.

spacingAlignment.description: Use even spacing between letters, shapes, and boundaries.
spacingAlignment.notes: Avoid crowded glyphs or inconsistent whitespace between text elements.

compositionBalance.description: Ensure the full logo feels centered, stable, and evenly weighted.
compositionBalance.notes: Use an implied grid to verify that everything aligns logically.

letterformConsistency.description: All characters in a wordmark must visually match in angle, curve style, terminal shape, and base logic.
letterformConsistency.notes: If one character has a pointed base, others in the same word should match that geometry. Avoid mismatched terminals, such as a sharp R beside a rounded S.

pixel-retro.name: Retro Pixel Arcade Style
pixel-retro.description: A nostalgic esports logo style inspired by arcade cabinets, 8-bit and 16-bit games, CRT displays, and retro game mascots. It should use pixel-perfect block construction while still feeling like a clean competitive team identity.

colorScheme.styleNote: Use bold arcade colors, strong contrast, and limited palette discipline.

visualCharacteristics.fillType: Flat pixel fills with no smooth gradients.
visualCharacteristics.stroke: Consistent pixel outline, usually 1 to 3 pixel units depending on scale.

renderingStyle.description: Use pixel art logic with clean grid snapping, crisp block silhouettes, and no anti-aliased painterly effects.

subjectMatter.type: Pixel mascot, gamepad, joystick, arcade monster, retro badge

wordmarkTreatment.preferredLineBreak: Use stacked block text when the team name has two words.

symmetryEnforcement.description: Ensure symmetry in pixel art by using mirrored or aligned blocks.
symmetryEnforcement.notes: Pixel outlines should be clean and consistently mirrored on both sides.

anchorRefinement.description: All edges should snap to the pixel grid.
anchorRefinement.notes: Avoid diagonal staircasing unless intentionally stylized.

strokeConsistency.description: Use consistent pixel stroke weight throughout.
strokeConsistency.notes: Avoid inconsistent pixel width or non-integer placements.

spacingAlignment.description: Ensure uniform spacing between text and icon blocks.
spacingAlignment.notes: Every element should snap to a base grid, such as 8px or 16px.

compositionBalance.description: Centralize mascot and ensure logo reads clearly even at small sizes.
compositionBalance.notes: Optimize for readability at both small avatar sizes and large merchandise sizes.

letterformConsistency.description: Ensure pixel characters use the same pixel size and styling logic throughout.
letterformConsistency.notes: Avoid inconsistent pixel width or clashing pixel edge behavior.

military-tactical.name: Tactical Military Logo Style
military-tactical.description: A clean, serious esports logo style with military, tactical, squad, FPS, and elite-unit influences. It should feel disciplined, precise, and operational rather than flashy.

colorScheme.styleNote: Desaturated greens, blacks, grays, metallic tones, tan, and controlled accent colors.

visualCharacteristics.lineQuality: Precise vector lines with minimal flare.
visualCharacteristics.fillType: Flat fill with subtle inner detail.
visualCharacteristics.stroke: Thin to medium borders with military patch discipline.

renderingStyle.description: Use flat emblem construction, clean patch geometry, disciplined spacing, and controlled contrast.
allowedEffects: patch stitching implied through simple shapes

subjectMatter.type: Weapon silhouette, monogram, emblem patch, tactical skull, shield, crosshair

wordmarkTreatment.style: military block lettering or stencil-inspired esports typography
wordmarkTreatment.preferredLineBreak: Use a compact nameplate below or across the badge.

symmetryEnforcement.description: Logos should feel centered and evenly distributed like military patches.
symmetryEnforcement.notes: All visual weight must be harmonized between left, right, top, and bottom.

anchorRefinement.description: Bevels, cutouts, and corners should have consistent vector transitions.
anchorRefinement.notes: No floating points or unfinished strokes.

strokeConsistency.description: Stroke widths should remain consistent across all elements.
strokeConsistency.notes: Create hierarchy through scale and placement, not random stroke weights.

spacingAlignment.description: Keep text and emblems properly aligned with military precision.
spacingAlignment.notes: Spacing should feel calculated and uniform.

compositionBalance.description: Visual hierarchy should place importance on the team identity first, not decoration.

letterformConsistency.description: Letterforms should share stroke weight, cut angles, stencil gaps, and width proportions.
letterformConsistency.notes: No mismatched corners or unrelated font weights in the same wordmark.

fantasy-darkcore.name: Fantasy Dark-Core Style
fantasy-darkcore.description: A dark, mystical esports logo style with fantasy, gothic, horror, demon, rune, and RPG-inspired elements. It should feel powerful, dramatic, and emblematic while remaining readable as a competitive logo.

colorScheme.styleNote: Use dark purples, black, silver, bone white, ember orange, crimson, or eerie accent colors.

visualCharacteristics.lineQuality: Illustrative vector lines with rune-like or blade-like detail.
visualCharacteristics.edgeStyle: Curved organic forms mixed with sharp gothic points.
visualCharacteristics.fillType: Mostly flat fills with controlled shadow planes and optional magical glow accents.
visualCharacteristics.stroke: Strong outer outline with controlled inner ornamentation.

renderingStyle.description: Use flat emblem construction with sharp fantasy silhouettes, hard shadows, and controlled magical accents.
restrictedEffects: thin decorative lines that disappear at small sizes

subjectMatter.type: Demonic figure, dragon, sword crest, arcane symbol, skull, hooded mage, beast

wordmarkTreatment.style: dark angular fantasy lettering with esports readability
wordmarkTreatment.preferredLineBreak: Use stacked wordmark or crest-integrated text.

symmetryEnforcement.description: Sigils, magical icons, horns, wings, and crests must be symmetrical or radially balanced.
symmetryEnforcement.notes: Uneven glow or asymmetry should feel intentional, not accidental.

anchorRefinement.description: Use smooth vector transitions and clean loops for scrolls, horns, flames, and cloth.
anchorRefinement.notes: Avoid over-clutter or inconsistent anchor weight.

strokeConsistency.description: Match inner detail line weights and outer edges for harmonious flow.
strokeConsistency.notes: Glows should fade evenly from center shapes and should not destroy the flat logo read.

spacingAlignment.description: Balance complex shapes with clean spacing so central figures stand out.
spacingAlignment.notes: Use space to emphasize hierarchy, not overload the eye.

compositionBalance.description: Maintain center mass and mystical aura around the core icon.
compositionBalance.notes: Ensure no part overpowers the main identity symbol.

letterformConsistency.description: All runic, gothic, or fantasy lettering must share geometry logic, stroke width, serif logic, and terminal shape.
letterformConsistency.notes: No inconsistent serif shapes, mismatched spikes, or misaligned decoration.

anime-action.name: Anime Action Esports Style
anime-action.description: A high-energy esports logo style inspired by anime protagonists, villains, speed lines, dramatic eyes, and stylized character mascots. It should feel expressive and dynamic without becoming a full illustration poster.

colorScheme.styleNote: Use strong contrast, dramatic accent colors, and flat anime shadow shapes.

visualCharacteristics.lineQuality: Clean manga-inspired vector lines with bold silhouette control.
visualCharacteristics.edgeStyle: Sharp hair, sharp eyes, angular clothing folds, and dynamic diagonal energy.
visualCharacteristics.stroke: Bold outer stroke with thinner interior expression lines.

renderingStyle.description: Use flat cel shading and stylized character energy while maintaining esports logo readability.
restrictedEffects: thin facial details that disappear at small sizes

subjectMatter.type: Anime mascot, masked fighter, ninja, samurai, cyber hero, villain face

wordmarkTreatment.style: angular esports lettering with anime motion cues
wordmarkTreatment.preferredLineBreak: Stacked or diagonal wordmark depending on motion direction.

symmetryEnforcement.description: Character expression may be dynamic, but the logo must remain visually balanced.
symmetryEnforcement.notes: Do not let one side become unintentionally heavier unless the pose clearly explains it.

anchorRefinement.description: Hair spikes, mask edges, and clothing folds should have deliberate vector angles.
anchorRefinement.notes: Avoid random spikes or uneven cuts.

strokeConsistency.description: Outer strokes and interior anime lines should have clear hierarchy.
strokeConsistency.notes: Thin detail lines should not compete with the main silhouette.

spacingAlignment.description: Keep the wordmark readable under or beside the character.
spacingAlignment.notes: Do not let speed lines interfere with text readability.

compositionBalance.description: The mascot should feel dynamic but logo-ready.
compositionBalance.notes: Favor iconic shape over detailed scene.

letterformConsistency.description: All letters should share the same slash angle, terminal shape, and motion logic.
letterformConsistency.notes: Avoid mixing rounded cartoon lettering with sharp anime battle shapes.

minimal-pro.name: Minimal Pro Esports Style
minimal-pro.description: A refined, clean esports logo style focused on simple geometry, strong negative space, premium restraint, and instantly recognizable identity marks.

colorScheme.styleNote: Use two to four colors maximum. Prioritize contrast and restraint.

visualCharacteristics.edgeStyle: Simple angular edges with precise curves only where needed.
visualCharacteristics.stroke: Minimal or none unless needed for readability.

renderingStyle.description: Use simple geometric forms, negative space, and precise alignment. Avoid decoration unless it strengthens recognition.

subjectMatter.type: Monogram, symbol, simplified mascot, abstract mark

wordmarkTreatment.preferredLineBreak: Single line for short names, stacked layout for two-word names.

symmetryEnforcement.description: Minimal marks must be highly balanced because small errors are more visible.
symmetryEnforcement.notes: Use strict alignment and avoid accidental asymmetry.

anchorRefinement.description: Every anchor point should feel necessary.
anchorRefinement.notes: Remove visual noise and unnecessary points.

strokeConsistency.description: Stroke and shape thickness should be mathematically consistent.

spacingAlignment.description: Use precise spacing and proportional relationships.
spacingAlignment.notes: Minimal logos need strong spacing discipline.

compositionBalance.description: The mark should feel stable, compact, and instantly recognizable.
compositionBalance.notes: Do not add elements that do not improve recognition.

letterformConsistency.description: All letters must share the same geometry system.
letterformConsistency.notes: Do not mix rounded and sharp terminals unless the whole system is designed around that contrast.

beforeFinalOutput: Confirm the exact team name is spelled correctly.
Confirm the requested colors are used as the dominant palette.
Confirm the selected style matches the team name and theme.
Confirm the logo uses flat vector-style fills unless glow or gradient was explicitly requested.
Confirm the mascot and badge are visually centered.
Confirm the outer border is consistent.
Confirm wordmark letters share the same geometry system.
Confirm sharp letters have matching sharp terminals.
Confirm the S does not have a rounded bottom-right terminal when neighboring letters use pointed feet.
Confirm the logo remains readable at small sizes.
Confirm the silhouette is clear without inner detail.
generationChecklist.qualityBar: The final image should feel like a finished professional esports logo, not a rough AI-generated concept.
